definitions.explanation: Describes a road or surface that has not been paved with asphalt or concrete. The prefix 未～ indicates something not yet done.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{未舗装|みほそう}だ。
{未舗装|みほそう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{道路|どうろ}→道路：01481_douro⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧⟦ぬかるみ→ぬかるむ：26941_nukarumu⟧やすい。
examples.english: Unpaved roads tend to get muddy after rain.

examples.japanese: ⟦{山奥|やまおく}→山奥：12438_yamaoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{未舗装|みほそう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{林道|りんどう}→林道：21917_rindou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{多|おお}く→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦{残|のこ}っている→残る：01187_nokoru⟧。
examples.english: There are still many unpaved forest roads deep in the mountains.

notes:
A compound of the prefix ⟦{未|み}→未〜：00277_mi⟧～ (not yet) and ⟦{舗装|ほそう}→舗装：08397_hosou⟧ (paving). Used as a no-adjective to describe roads or surfaces that have not been paved.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {未舗装|みほそう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧: unpaved road (no-adjective + ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧)
- {未舗装|みほそう}だ: is unpaved (predicate)

THE {未|み}～ PREFIX:
This prefix attaches to Sino-Japanese words to mean "not yet":
- ⟦{未完成|みかんせい}→未完成：13066_mikansei⟧: incomplete
- ⟦{未経験|みけいけん}→未経験：17726_mikeiken⟧: inexperienced
- ⟦{未確認|みかくにん}→未確認：22493_mikakunin⟧: unconfirmed
- ⟦{未使用|みしよう}→未使用：21316_mishiyou⟧: unused

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{舗装|ほそう}→舗装：08397_hosou⟧: paving — the base word
- ⟦{砂利道|じゃりみち}→砂利道：16083_jarimichi⟧: gravel road
- {土道|つちみち}: dirt road
- ⟦アスファルト→アスファルト：10736_asufaruto⟧: asphalt
